mapper.insert: INSERT INTO iot_device(tenant_id, product_key, device_name, device_key, device_type, secret, status, connect_status, protocol_type, protocol_version, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{productKey}, #{deviceName}, #{deviceKey}, #{deviceType}, #{secret}, #{status}, #{connectStatus}, CASE WHEN #{protocolType} IS NULL OR #{protocolType} = '' THEN 'MQTT_ALINK_JSON' ELSE #{protocolType} END, #{protocolVersion}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
mapper.select: SELECT id, tenant_id, product_key, device_name, device_key, device_type, secret, status, connect_status, last_connected_at, last_disconnected_at, protocol_type, protocol_version, created_at, updated_at FROM iot_device WHERE product_key = #{productKey} ORDER BY created_at DESC

SELECT id, tenant_id, product_key, device_name, device_key, device_type, secret, status, connect_status, last_connected_at, last_disconnected_at, protocol_type, protocol_version, created_at, updated_at FROM iot_device ORDER BY created_at DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE iot_device SET connect_status = #{connectStatus}, last_connected_at = CASE WHEN #{connectStatus} = 'connected' THEN CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ELSE last_connected_at END, last_disconnected_at = CASE WHEN #{connectStatus} = 'disconnected' THEN CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ELSE last_disconnected_at END, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE product_key = #{productKey} AND device_key = #{deviceKey}
